acceptance_criteria.description: CSRF and pre-session nonce/signature components require non-empty URL-safe unpadded Base64 in addition to HMAC verification; HMAC comparison remains constant-time and Origin remains an exact match.
evidence: tests/unit/identity/session-and-csrf.test.ts rejects a correctly HMAC-signed standard/padded Base64 nonce and padded signature, asserts generated wire grammar, and covers exact Origin mismatch/missing cases.
src/server/services/identity/csrf.ts validates nonce and signature with the unpadded base64url grammar before retaining the existing timingSafeEqual verification.

acceptance_criteria.description: Missing, expired, malformed, wrongly bound, wrongly signed and Origin-failing anonymous route requests return the identical safe 403 csrf_failed response and are logged under D-47.
evidence: tests/integration/api/auth/csrf-boundary.test.ts exercises nine route-level failures through the real composition and PostgreSQL boundary and asserts the exact safe error shape.
tests/unit/auth/api-routes.test.ts proves missing and invalid pre-session denials record auth.csrf_failed and never call login; src/app/api/v1/auth/http.ts centralizes the single safe log event.

acceptance_criteria.description: Hosted cookies use __Host names and required attributes, pre-sessions last exactly 30 minutes, and successful login clears the pre-session binding.
evidence: tests/unit/identity/session-and-csrf.test.ts asserts exact hosted session and pre-session serialization, including Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Path=/, no Domain and Max-Age=1800, plus exact expiresAt.
tests/integration/api/auth/csrf-boundary.test.ts proves successful real login returns the pre-session clearing cookie with Max-Age=0.

acceptance_criteria.description: Logout, expiry, suspension and explicit account-session revocation invalidate subsequent use of the old session-bound CSRF token.
evidence: tests/integration/api/auth/csrf-boundary.test.ts creates real accounts/sessions/tokens and proves each old authenticated mutation is rejected with 401 after the corresponding invalidation event.
